draft_lottery_2027.source: NBA.com Board of Governors 3-2-1 Lottery approval
rules: three worst teams draft-relegated from 3 balls to 2
draft-relegated teams cannot fall below No. 12
own pick cannot be No. 1 in consecutive drafts
own pick cannot be top five in three consecutive drafts
new top-12 through top-15 protections prohibited
draft_lottery_2027.implementation_boundary: v0.37 presents the game-engine lottery probabilities and commissioner event while the existing certified future-pick ownership/protection ledger remains authoritative.

bird_rights_v0_20.policy: Exact where transactionally actionable; conservative continuity floor where an exact historical label cannot affect gameplay before Bird rights are deterministically reached.
